output.note: Withheld amounts are per-account TransferFeeAmount.withheld_amount and the mint-level TransferFeeConfig.withheld_amount, both u64 in token minor units, pinned at solana-program/token-2022 commit b5b7511e5d4f19a6a118b858d83a7fe3b0017b1e. recomputed_account_sum counts only accounts whose mint matches the declared mint: the harvest instruction skips a wrong-mint account with MintMismatch instead of moving its fees. post_harvest_mint_withheld is what the mint would accumulate after harvesting every mint-matching account; the on-chain addition is checked_add, so an amount past u64 fails the harvest with TokenError::Overflow, reported here as post_harvest_would_overflow_u64. Mint and authority comparisons are string equality on the pasted values; this kernel reads nothing on-chain.
